sub_agent_reviews.summary: One merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety; selected Fara1.5 from the unified table using Microsoft ICML 2026 current-week session evidence.
Main agent read the Microsoft Research article, ICML session evidence, and Fara repository context, then extracted training flow, benchmark numbers, safety boundaries, and deployment limits.
Markdown uses TL;DR, problem sections, tables, formulas, pseudocode, Mermaid, benchmark interpretation, failure cases, and more than 5000 Chinese characters.
